sentences.en: I can't stand him holding forth about his life experience.
sentences.zh: 我受不了他总是滔滔不绝地讲述自己的经历。

sentences.en: The fire burned brightly, giving forth a comforting warmth.
sentences.zh: 火焰燃烧得非常旺盛，散发出一种令人感到温暖的光芒。

sentences.en: From that day forth he lived with the boy.
sentences.zh: 从那天起，他就和那个男孩一起生活了。
